async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Search for 'Rocco Gym Tank'
    search_box = page.get_by_role("group", name="Search").get_by_role("textbox")
    await search_box.fill("Rocco Gym Tank")
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Ensure results are loaded
    # Click the Edit link for Rocco Gym Tank
    rocco_row = page.get_by_role("row").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Rocco Gym Tank", exact=False))
    edit_link = rocco_row.get_by_role("link", name="Edit")
    await edit_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
